C0956.title: Chengdu Police Report Staged Blind-Date Videos: Six Detained for Fabricating Identities
C0956.summary: On March 13, 2025, police in Wuhou District, Chengdu, reported a staged blind-date video case used for traffic generation. According to the notice, a company organized people to fabricate identities, write false scripts, and publish blind-date videos to mislead the public and gain traffic for profit. Police imposed detention and other measures on the people involved. The incident reflects a typical path in which staged accounts fabricate jobs, income, and relationships to create viral hooks. Platform governance therefore needs to identify institutional operation, script production, and monetization chains behind the accounts, not only remove individual videos.
